# Requirements Quality Checklist: Dual-Panel File Manager

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage of requirements across spec.md, plan.md, data-model.md, and contracts/services.md — used as author self-review before implementation
**Created**: 2026-02-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are requirements defined for what happens when no GCP projects are configured in `projects.json`? (empty list or missing file) [Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements specified for the first-launch experience when no `settings.json` exists? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the OAuth2 client ID/secret embedding strategy documented as a requirement, or only in research.md? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for what the UI displays while a GCS listing is loading? (loading indicator, skeleton, spinner) [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements specified for the panel behavior when a GCS listing exceeds the 1000-object page size? (pagination UX, "Load more" behavior) [Gap, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are local-to-local copy/move requirements explicitly stated alongside cross-storage transfers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for what happens when both panels are set to GCS and a GCS-to-GCS transfer is initiated? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are requirements specified for the behavior when a transfer is paused? (data-model.md defines PAUSED state but spec.md does not mention pause) [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are requirements defined for the "Rename" conflict resolution option — specifically the renaming pattern/suffix? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are requirements defined for keyboard shortcut discoverability? (tooltip, menu labels, help dialog) [Gap, Spec §FR-019]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 - Is "human-readable format" for file sizes quantified with specific formatting rules? (e.g., KB/MB/GB thresholds, decimal precision) [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "progress indicator" in FR-009 specific about the UI component? (dialog, status bar, inline indicator) [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "appropriate error messages" in FR-018 defined with specific content requirements beyond "suggested action"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the behavior of "Cmd/Ctrl+C then Cmd/Ctrl+V" two-step copy clearly specified? (What state is held between C and V? Can user navigate between them? Does clipboard persist across panel switches?) [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are "minimum required permissions" for OAuth scopes explicitly listed in the spec rather than only in research.md? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is "user-configurable setting" for concurrent transfers specific about where this setting lives? (settings dialog, config file only, both) [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK017 - Is the delete keyboard shortcut consistent between spec.md (Cmd/Ctrl+Delete or Delete) and quickstart.md navigation table? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK018 - Does the data model's `TransferOperation.PAUSED` state align with spec requirements? (spec only mentions cancel, not pause) [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are the `ConflictResolution` enum values (OVERWRITE, SKIP, RENAME, ASK) consistent with the spec's "overwrite, skip, or rename" options? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the Properties shortcut consistent? (quickstart.md shows Cmd/Ctrl+I or Alt+Enter; spec FR-019 lists "properties" but doesn't specify keys) [Consistency, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are the `SourceType` enum values (LOCAL, GCS_PROJECT, GCS_BUCKET) consistently used across data-model.md, contracts/services.md, and spec user stories? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 - Can SC-001 ("within 3 clicks or keystrokes") be objectively measured given the application starts at home directory? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is SC-002 ("<5 seconds for <1000 objects") defined with a specific network/hardware baseline? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK024 - Can SC-008 ("90% of common file operations via keyboard") be objectively calculated? Is the denominator defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is SC-011 ("within 60 seconds of clicking Sign in") realistic given dependency on Google's sign-in page and user typing speed? Does it include time-to-type credentials? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where the user's OAuth refresh token is revoked by Google (not just expired)? [Coverage, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for simultaneous transfers running when the user signs out? (in-progress GCS operations) [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements specified for copying a file that is currently being modified by another process? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are requirements defined for how the application handles GCS bucket-level operations that the user's IAM role doesn't permit? (e.g., list buckets allowed but list objects denied) [Coverage, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements specified for the application behavior when the local disk runs out of space during a GCS→local download? [Coverage, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for what happens when the user attempts to copy/move a GCS object with a storage class that has retrieval costs? (COLDLINE/ARCHIVE) [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are requirements specified for symlink handling during local file browsing and copy/move? [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK033 - Are memory requirements defined for specific scenarios? (e.g., 200MB overall but what about during 10 concurrent large file transfers?) [Completeness, Spec §III Performance]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are accessibility requirements defined? (screen reader support, keyboard-only navigation, high contrast mode) [Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are logging/diagnostic requirements specified? (log file location, log levels, what events to log) [Gap]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are network timeout requirements defined for GCS operations? (connection timeout, read timeout, retry policy) [Gap]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are data integrity requirements specified for transfers? (checksum verification after copy, md5_hash in data-model but no spec requirement to verify) [Gap, Spec §FR-017]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK038 - Is the assumption "Python 3.10+ installed" reconciled with the packaging requirement "MUST NOT require users to install Python separately"? [Assumption, Constitution §Packaging]
- [ ] CHK039 - Is the dependency on `keyring` library validated for all target platforms? (keyring backends may require additional setup on some Linux/Windows configurations) [Dependency]
- [ ] CHK040 - Is the assumption of "standard GCS pricing" sufficient, or should the application warn users about egress/retrieval costs for operations? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline below each item
- Items referencing `[Gap]` indicate requirements that may need to be added to spec.md
- Items referencing `[Consistency]` indicate potential conflicts between documents
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001-CHK040) for easy reference
